payload.reason: The evidence provides specific evaluation criteria and metrics used to assess the generated text, including edit distance, word error rate, and comparisons against reference texts.

claims.text: The evaluation includes measuring the edit distance between generated text and its corrected variant, reflecting the effort needed for corrections.
The word error rate (WER) of the generated text compared to its corrected variant is reported as 5.6%.
The evaluation also involves comparing the output for each unique meaning representation (MR) against multiple references to obtain maximum scores.
The model's performance is evaluated using BLEU scores during hyperparameter tuning.
